RegistryEntry.description: A registry change. Action decides what happens; without Action, a value is set.

Action.description: Set (default): create or change a value. RemoveValue: remove one value. ClearValues: remove all values of the key, keep its subkeys. ClearKey: remove all values and subkeys, keep the key. RemoveKey: remove the key with everything in it. ClearValues, ClearKey and RemoveKey are refused for a hive root or a key directly below it.

Path.description: Registry key, for example HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Example, HKCU:\Software\Example or HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Example.

Name.description: Value name; an empty string is the key's (Default) value. Required for Set and RemoveValue.

Type.description: Value type, required for Set: String, ExpandString, MultiString, Binary, DWord or QWord.

Value.description: Value data, required for Set. String and ExpandString: text. MultiString: a list of texts. Binary: hex text such as '01 0A FF' or a list of numbers 0-255. DWord and QWord: a number, or text in decimal ('16') or hexadecimal ('0x10').

Comment.description: Technician notes; ignored when applying the configuration.

ScheduledTasks.description: Scheduled tasks, each with its XML inline or in a file exported from Task Scheduler.

Enabled.description: Whether the registered task is enabled.

Xml.description: Complete task XML, as returned by Export-ScheduledTask. Use either Xml or XmlFile.

XmlFile.description: Task XML file exported from Task Scheduler (right-click a task, Export...), relative to the USB root unless it is a full path. Use either Xml or XmlFile.

RunAsUser.description: Account the task runs as, such as 'kiosk', 'CONTOSO\svc-backup' or a SID like S-1-5-19 (LOCAL SERVICE). Without it, the task runs as SYSTEM.

RunAsPassword.description: Password of RunAsUser. The task then runs whether or not the user is signed in, with the password saved in Task Scheduler. Use a {{password:...}} placeholder to ask for it at restore time instead of storing it in this file.
